instructions.text: Take the yolk of the egg and put it into a small bowl and crumble it down
Put into it the butter and mix it smooth with a spoon
Add the salt, pepper, mustard and the cheese, mixing each well
Then put in the tablespoonful of vinegar, which will make it the proper thickness
If vinegar is not relished, then use cold water instead
Spread this between two biscuits or pieces of oat-cake

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Take the yolk of the egg and put it into a small bowl and crumble it down
2. Put into it the butter and mix it smooth with a spoon
3. Add the salt, pepper, mustard and the cheese, mixing each well
4. Then put in the tablespoonful of vinegar, which will make it the proper thickness
5. If vinegar is not relished, then use cold water instead
6. Spread this between two biscuits or pieces of oat-cake
7. Season to taste if preferred
